# Unrelated code purge keep overrides

Delete-candidate paths that must **stay on disk** so Hallulium
still `e build`s after the purge in
[`unrelated code purge.md`](unrelated%20code%20purge.md).

These are files the delete scan marked unused, but a ninja-needed
source still `#include`s them or a needed-dir build file still
`import()`s them (`ninja -t inputs` misses many headers / `.gni`).

Default action: **subtract from the purge**. Only delete one if
you also remove every referencer (cut-and-fix).

Companion: [`unrelated code purge reference fix.md`](unrelated%20code%20purge%20reference%20fix.md)
(GN dep/source/label edits for trees you do remove).

Generated: 2026-11-17T07:17:12.437Z

## Stats

| Metric | Count |
|---|---:|
| Delete candidates | 747715 |
| Keep files (ninja + policy) | 59362 |
| Ninja-needed sources scanned for includes | 30669 |
| Import-keep edges | 3681 |
| **Keep-override files** | **22797** |
| Reference edges | 182314 |

An **edge** is one `#include` or `import()` from a kept file to
a keep-override path.
